title: ci-cd-pipeline.md command-parity: 5 of 38 sections are pinned — carry the remaining appetite with a MEASURED denominator, and evaluate inverting the rule's default before spending ~30 rounds
body:
Successor to **#8420**, which triage closed as `completed` at 2026-09-14T02:2xZ. ⛔ This is **not** a re-file of #8420's defects — every instance that card described is fixed, pinned and landed (PRs #8878 `e09ae85f1`, #8890 `b686ebf7d`, both ancestors of `main`). This card carries only the part of #8420 that was still live: **the remaining pinning appetite**, with a denominator measured today instead of #8420's falsified one.

Filed by the triage seat (#6015, `session_01PAMZt3owWHe7CMyTzrDkwF`) so the disposition has a named carrier — ⛔ an acceptance note with no carrier is not a disposition, which is the failure #8420 itself demonstrated twice.

## Measured on `origin/main` `72932dfcd2733c020c7c99aba7cebb42ecd024ef` (2026-09-14T02:15:06Z)

```
heading-form sections naming a .yml   38     grep -cE '^#{1,6} .*\(`[^`]+\.yml`\)\s*$'
workflow .yml files                   37     git ls-tree --name-only origin/main -- .github/workflows/
commandParity() USE sites              5     (6 hits − 1 definition at :903)
page size                          2,876 lines / 247,158 bytes
```

The five pinned surfaces: `ci.yml` job-table rows (`:1122`), `lint.yml` (`:1229`), `vi-mock-specifiers.yml` (`:2516`), `shadcn-check.yml` (`:2524`), and the `byGate` mapping over the four take-3 sections (`:2695`) — `performance-budget.yml`, `skill-examples.yml`, `changeset-release.yml`, `spec-range-floors.yml`.

⚠️ **Why the denominator is the point of this card.** #8420's body says **34**. Its census comment said **36**. It is **38** today. And the dev on #8420's fourth dispatch measured a container whose working checkout answered `ls .github/workflows/*.yml | wc -l` → **34** — *exactly #8420's figure* — because that checkout was ~3 weeks stale. ⇒ a seat re-deriving 「24 of 34」 there would have found it **CONFIRMED by a stale tree**. ⛔ Not a wrong number — a right-looking number from a different population.

⚠️ ⛔ **Triage could not reproduce that stale reading** and does not assert it as a repo property: in this seat's own container the working tree answers **37**, agreeing with `origin/main`. ⇒ the hazard is **per-container and silent**, so the defence is to read `git show origin/main:PATH` **unconditionally**, ⛔ not to check whether a checkout happens to be stale.

## ⭐ The direction to evaluate FIRST — ⛔ before spending ~30 rounds

#8420's closing comment `#issuecomment-5607640619` priced the remaining work at **roughly thirty rounds at one section per PR**. ⛔ Do not start that without first testing a cheaper shape, because **the objection that originally forbade a sweep has been discharged by #8420's own later work**.

#8420 refused a sweep for a stated reason: a naive pairing flagged **24 of 34** sections, and *「a gate that cries wolf gets switched off rather than fixed」*. That was correct **at the time** — there was no way to tell a legitimate exception from a defect.

⭐ **There is now.** #8420's census `#issuecomment-5607595817` classified all 36 sections and was ACCEPTed:

| class | n |
|:--|--:|
| already pinned | 4 |
| **true defect** | 4 — since pinned and landed |
| **legitimate exception** | **11** |
| no job to compare | **4** |
| agrees, none of the above | **13** |

⇒ the false-positive population is **named** — 11 + 4 = **15 explicit exclusions**. So the shape worth measuring first is **inverting the rule's polarity**: pin every section by default and carry those 15 as an explicit, commented exception list, rather than opting sections in one PR at a time. **One PR instead of thirty**, and it closes the class rather than the instances — a section added tomorrow is pinned on arrival instead of joining a 30-deep backlog.

⚠️ ⛔ **Those five census figures are the reading of #8420's dev and its `domain:devx` seat, ⛔ not triage's** — triage did not re-open `#issuecomment-5607595817`. Their arithmetic sums to 36, and two independent readers agree on it, which is why it is quoted. **Deliverable 1 is to re-read that census and re-derive the exception list against today's 38**, since it was taken at 36 and two sections have appeared since.

## Deliverables, in order

1. **Re-read the census** `#issuecomment-5607595817` and re-derive its classification against the **38** sections on a current `origin/main`. Name the 2 sections that appeared since, and classify them. ⛔ Do not take 36 as the denominator.
2. **Measure the inverted-default shape**: with the 15 exclusions encoded, how many sections go red? ⭐ If the answer is ~0, the sweep #8420 forbade is now safe and this card is one PR.
3. **If — and only if — step 2 shows the exception list cannot carry it**, fall back to section-by-section, and say in this card's thread **which sections** and **why the list failed**. ⛔ Do not silently switch to the 30-round plan.

## ⛔ Stop clauses

- ⛔ **If the repair requires WEAKENING any gate** — relaxing a parity assertion, widening an accept set, or making a currently-blocking check advisory — **stop and report.** 门禁削弱 is the maintainer's floor, ⛔ not this card's. Strengthening coverage from inside the rule is in scope; loosening it is not.
- ⛔ **If the 「alias question」 is still unsettled** — sections naming the `pnpm check:*` alias while the workflow invokes `node scripts/…` directly, which #8420 records as *「a real and deliberate distinction」* — **that is a decision, not a judgement call.** Report it rather than picking a side in an implementation.
- ⛔ **No prose rewrite of sections that already agree with their jobs.** This card pins; it does not re-word 38 sections.

## ⛔ Not in scope

⛔ #8420's two named instances (fixed, pinned, landed). ⛔ Re-deriving the naive 「24 of N」 figure as a deliverable in its own right — it is an input to step 2, ⛔ not a product.

Back-links: **#8420** (closed `completed`, the parent), #8015 (generalised `commandParity` to module scope), #3653 (the `ci.yml` job table), PRs #8878 / #8890.
